title: Canonical Agent Network Graph
description: Unified graph model for the agent network canvas. Same shape as React Flow (MuleSoft Agent Visualizer): use nodes/edges directly, no adapter. Produced by Visualizer (runtime) and GraphQL+Exchange (design) adapters.

nodes.description: Graph nodes: brokers and their children (agents, MCPs, LLMs).

edges.description: Directed edges from broker to children (source → target).

x-reactFlow.description: Canonical is React Flow shape. Use graph.nodes and graph.edges directly (node.position required; edge.source / edge.target).

NodeType.description: Node kind for layout and styling; maps to React Flow custom node type.

CanonicalDependency.description: Design mode: dependency from Exchange API.

CanonicalConnectionRef.description: Design mode: connection ref from agent-network YAML (kind + name).

Position.description: Required for React Flow. Default from producers; layout can update.

CanonicalNode.description: A node in the canonical graph: broker or child (agent, MCP, LLM). React Flow shape.

position.description: Required. Default from producers; layout can update.

instanceIds.description: Runtime only: instance IDs from Visualizer prod_instances_map.

exchangeAssetId.description: Optional: Exchange assetId for catalog link.

brokerRuntimeId.description: Design: from YAML brokers key. Correlates to runtime node id.

mcpRefs.description: Design: from YAML links or connections where kind is mcp.

rawYaml.description: Design: full agent-network YAML for this asset (e.g. show in UI when selected).

CanonicalEdge.description: Directed edge (React Flow shape). type drives dashed (designTime) vs solid (runTime).

source.description: Node id of the source (React Flow edge.source).

target.description: Node id of the target (React Flow edge.target).

type.description: designTime = from catalog/YAML (dashed). runTime = from Visualizer (solid).
